verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google spend needs its tracking fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 31 leads at a cost of $136.63 per lead across $4,235.67 in total ad spend — and every one of those leads came from Meta, not Google. Google Ads consumed $2,850.44 of that budget and logged only 4 attributed conversions, which does not reflect reality; conversion tracking is being repaired so that spend is measured accurately going forward. On the pipeline side, 117 opportunities have been created in your CRM against 0 won and 0 appointments booked, which means active follow-up on existing leads is the highest-leverage move available right now. We are addressing the tracking issue and the overdue launch milestones — including LSA verification and Meta retargeting — so that next period's numbers reflect the full picture and both channels are working as planned.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all sourced from Meta
spent on Google Ads this period, with conversion tracking being repaired to reflect true results
